status: Experimental, lint passed; integration and fault validation pending

new_ports.loader_committed_end: 32-bit exclusive byte end of contiguous, successfully acknowledged source writes in the current task, synchronous to clk
new_ports.loader_fault: Producer-detected failed write or abort; while busy it enters the existing real response drain path with error code 0x1b (transport errors retain priority)

producer_requirements: Initialize the shared source to poison; every task's source word is written through the same original official bus path before it can be consumed.
Advance committed_end only after originating successful write ACK. Keep it aligned, monotonic, within the task's source allocation, and stable during any failure drain.
Do not rewrite a committed source word. All writes for this epoch are ordered contiguous full-word writes.
Establish a fresh producer epoch before START. The conditional benchmark starts only after all 202 header/metadata words have received successful ACKs.
On a write failure, do not publish the failed word or later words as committed; assert loader_fault and drain accepted producer traffic.
Do not use a blocking CPU WAIT before finishing production when the same CPU performs the source stores.
consumer: Both descriptor valid and ready are gated until nonzero count, source-relative base and full 35-bit base+4*count range are committed. An accepted descriptor is never gated retroactively. No offered bus command or originating response is modified by the watermark.
measurement: Conditional BFM loader at the existing CPU port of the same CPU/DMA merge, unchanged OUTSTANDING4/ONE_PER_PORT01 and original official fabric; first producer offer and first accepted source write to final originating output-marker ACK are both recorded. No source initialization is omitted from these windows.
limits: No actual E203 CPU executes in this conditional producer benchmark.
The official platform loader interface, rate and timing boundary remain unresolved; this model does not prove that the official loader can provide these acknowledgments or overlap behavior.
No vendor fabric change, third master or shared SRAM bypass is authorized by this experiment.
All producer invariants need executable verification; lint alone proves neither protocol correctness nor performance.
No manufacturer, physical area, STA, whole-SoC energy or official600 acceptance claim.
